data.content:
Lincoln team news

Lincoln are without their captain, Tendayi Darikwa, who is out long-term with a cruciate tear. Also, striker Mason Melia is injured with a thigh problem. The Imps go into this game on the back of a 3-0 defeat to Sheffield United. Therefore, their managerial duo of former West Ham player Chris Cohen and Tom Shaw will likely make multiple changes.

Lincoln vs. West Ham lineups [...] Predicted West Ham lineup vs. Lincoln: Hermansen; Veltman, Mavropanos, Kilman, Morato; Bowen, Orford, Engels, Austbø; Kante; Castellanos

Predicted Lincoln lineup vs. West Ham: Wickens; Elerewe, Bradley, Towler; Hamer, Bayliss, Konak, Elder; Street, House, Ladefoged

Lincoln vs. West Ham prediction [...] Kyle Walker-Peters was also taken off at half-time in the QPR game. Joel Veltman could start ahead of him. Keiber Lamadrid is reportedly an injury concern. It also does not seem like Edson Alvarez will be reintegrated into the squad any time soon.
